description: Rule for selecting the RQ3 topics from the CIS monthly barometers. Fixed before the CIS data were downloaded. Rationale in docs/TOPIC_SELECTION.md.

source.question: ¿Cuál es, a su juicio, el principal problema que existe actualmente en España? ¿Y el segundo? ¿Y el tercero? (RESPUESTA ESPONTÁNEA). (MULTIRRESPUESTA).
source.measure: TOTAL column: percentage of respondents who name the category as any of their three problems

aggregation.within_barometer: sum of the TOTAL percentages of the categories mapped to the topic; a category missing from a barometer counts as 0
aggregation.across_barometers: mean over all barometers in the window

exclusion_groups.political: Names the political class, the parties, the government or the state of politics as the problem, not a policy area. Leaders' posts of this kind go to the residual category.
exclusion_groups.diffuse: No identifiable policy area that a keyword registry could match.

matching: Patterns are Python regular expressions searched in the category label after lower-casing, removing accents and collapsing whitespace. Exclusions are checked first, then the topics in the order listed, and the first match wins. A category that matches no exclusion and no mapping competes on its own under its CIS label.
